1) PRIORIDADE 1 (Back-to-Back com Check-in no Mesmo Dia): 1023 32nd St, Oakland (OAK-HOM-001). Os hospedes saem as 11:00 AM e os novos hospedes entram as 5:00 PM amanha mesmo. Por favor, comece pela 1023 32nd St entre 11:00 AM e 5:00 PM.

cicilia_whatsapp_dispatch.urgent_tomorrow_oct_18_en:

TOMORROW'S GAME PLAN (Sunday, Oct 18):
1) PRIORITY 1 (Same-Day Back-to-Back Check-In): 1023 32nd St, Oakland (OAK-HOM-001). Departing guests check out at 11:00 AM and incoming guests check in at 5:00 PM tomorrow. Please prioritize 1023 32nd St first between 11:00 AM and 5:00 PM.
2) PRIORITY 2 (Flexible Turnover, No Same-Day Check-In): 5540 Estates Dr (5-BR Entire Home, OAK-HOM-002). Guests also check out tomorrow (Oct 18) at 11:00 AM, but there is NO incoming guest tomorrow (next booking is Nov 21). You can clean 5540 Estates Dr right after 32nd St or on Monday (Oct 19), whichever works best for you!
